description_en: Translates the speech and on-screen text in a video into a target language. You can select speech subtitle translation, on-screen text translation, or both. This operation is applicable to scenarios such as multilingual distribution of e-commerce videos, international social media marketing, and global brand advertising. This API uses an asynchronous invocation mode. After you submit a translation task, you can obtain the TaskId and poll the task status by calling the query operation until the task is completed and the result is returned
description_zh:
视频翻译 API 支持将视频中的语音和画面文字翻译为目标语言。您可以单独选择语音字幕翻译、画面文字翻译，或同时选择两种能力。适用于电商视频多语言分发、国际社交媒体营销、全球品牌广告投放等场景。
API 采用异步调用模式：提交翻译任务后获取 TaskId，通过查询接口轮询任务状态直至完成后获取结果
name: VideoTranslation

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video. Supported formats: MP4 and MOV. Maximum size: 200 MB
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: Required when the capabilities include speech. Optional when only visual is selected and EraseOnly is set to true. If specified in this case, it is ignored. Required in all other cases
parameters.help_zh: 包含 speech 时始终必填；仅 visual 且 EraseOnly=true 时可不传，传入则忽略；其他情况必填
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: The original language of the video (source language). For supported languages, see Language support
parameters.help_zh: 原视频语言（源语言），支持范围见“语言支持”
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The list of translation features. Valid values: speech and visual. You can select both. At least one feature must be specified. Duplicate values are not accepted
parameters.help_zh: 翻译能力列表：speech、visual，支持同时选择；至少一项，不接受重复值
parameters.name: capabilities

parameters.help_en: Applicable only when the capabilities include speech. Valid values: erase: erases the original subtitles only. replace: replaces the original subtitles with translated subtitles, which means erasing the original subtitles and adding subtitles synchronized with the translated speech. If this parameter is not specified, the original subtitles are not processed, which means neither erasing the original subtitles nor adding new subtitles
parameters.help_zh: 仅包含 speech 时可传；erase：仅消除原字幕；replace：替换为翻译后的字幕，即消除原字幕并添加与翻译后语音同步的字幕；不传：不处理原字幕，即不消除原字幕，也不添加新字幕
parameters.name: subtitle_mode

parameters.help_en: Applicable only when the capabilities include visual. Valid values: true: erases the on-screen text without translation. false: translates the on-screen text. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 仅包含 visual 时可传；true：仅消除画面文字，不翻译；false：翻译画面文字。默认 false
parameters.name: erase_only

parameters.help_en: Applicable only when the capabilities include visual. Valid values: true: erases brand logos. false: retains brand logos. Default value: false. This parameter is independent of EraseOnly
parameters.help_zh: 仅包含 visual 时可传；true：消除品牌标识（Logo）；false：保留品牌标识（Logo）。默认 false；与 EraseOnly 独立
parameters.name: remove_logo

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the quality check for on-screen text processing. This parameter takes effect only when the capabilities include visual and this parameter is explicitly set to true. If only speech is selected, this parameter is ignored, no quality check is performed, no quality check fields are returned, and no error is reported due to this parameter. Enabling the quality check may increase the processing time. Do not enable it unless necessary. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 包含 visual 且显式传 true 时启用画面文字处理质检；仅选择 speech 时忽略此参数，不执行质检、不返回质检字段，也不因该参数报错。开启质检可能延长等待时间，如无必要建议不开启。默认 false
parameters.name: enable_quality_check

Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

Data.description_en: The result of the asynchronous task submission

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task, which is used for subsequent queries
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询
TaskId.title_en: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询
TaskId.title_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询

Message.title_en: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values: true: The call is successful. false: The call fails
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败
Success.title_en: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败。
Success.title_zh: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败。
